playx.disabled.en: Live gameplay is not enabled for this environment.
playx.disabled.zh-Hans: 当前环境尚未启用实时玩法

playx.unknown.body.en: The server may have received your action. Check the result before submitting anything else.
playx.unknown.body.zh-Hans: 服务端可能已收到操作，请先核对结果，不要重复提交

playx.run.end.detail.en: This ends your saved timer. It does not mark unfinished tasks complete or grant rewards.
playx.run.end.detail.zh-Hans: 这会结束已保存的计时，不会完成未完成任务或发放奖励

playx.run.saveFailed.en: The remote timer update was not confirmed. Your local state is retained.
playx.run.saveFailed.zh-Hans: 远端计时更新尚未确认，已保留本机状态

playx.ending.empty.en: There is no completed story fragment yet.
playx.ending.empty.zh-Hans: 还没有已完成的故事片段

playx.leaderboard.metric.en: Ranked by completed nodes, as reported by the server.
playx.leaderboard.metric.zh-Hans: 按服务端返回的完成节点数排名

playx.leaderboard.me.zh-Hans: 我的名次与完成节点数

playx.review.detail.en: Send this action to the current journey? Completion will be checked against server state.
playx.review.detail.zh-Hans: 将此操作提交到当前旅程？完成状态将以服务端回读为准

playx.hints.consequence.en: The shown point cost may be charged. Puzzle hints can lower your score cap and are recorded by the server.
playx.hints.consequence.zh-Hans: 可能扣除所示积分，谜题提示会影响解谜分上限，并由服务端记录

playx.media.audio.en: Audio is attached to this task

playx.media.image.en: An image is attached to this task

playx.media.uploadGate.en: Photo upload requires an accepted media provider. Selecting a photo does not complete the task.
playx.media.uploadGate.zh-Hans: 照片上传需通过媒体验收，选择照片不代表任务完成

playx.merchant.notice.en: Arrival and photo evidence are separate steps. The merchant confirms completion.
playx.merchant.notice.zh-Hans: 到店和照片凭证是独立步骤，完成状态由商家核销确认

playx.merchant.consentGate.en: Showing a merchant verification code requires the exact store-scoped consent and verified code provider.
playx.merchant.consentGate.zh-Hans: 出示商家核销码需要当前门店的精确授权及已验收的码服务

playx.node.unavailable.en: This task is no longer visible in the current session.
playx.node.unavailable.zh-Hans: 当前会话中此任务已不可见

playx.session.changed.en: Your session changed. Reopen this journey to continue.
playx.session.changed.zh-Hans: 登录会话已变更，请重新进入旅程

playx.unsupported.en: This action is not available for the current task.
playx.unsupported.zh-Hans: 此任务暂不支持该操作

playx.error.en: This result could not be confirmed. Refresh to check the latest state.
playx.error.zh-Hans: 暂时无法确认结果，请刷新核对最新状态

playx.rejected.en: The server did not accept this action

playx.reward.authority.en: Only returned values are shown. Missing rewards are not estimated.
playx.reward.authority.zh-Hans: 只显示服务端返回的值，不估算缺失奖励

playx.lead.notStarted.en: This team run has not started yet.

playx.lead.review.en: Confirm this action for the current team.
playx.lead.review.zh-Hans: 确认对当前队伍执行此操作

playx.lead.settle.consequence.en: This asks the server to end and settle the current team run. Review the activity before continuing.
playx.lead.settle.consequence.zh-Hans: 这将请求服务端结束并结算当前队伍行程，请确认场次后继续

playx.lead.unknown.en: The last team action is still unconfirmed. Do not send it again.
playx.lead.unknown.zh-Hans: 上次队伍操作结果尚未确认，请勿重复发送

playx.device.capture.zh-Hans: 使用已验收的设备服务

playx.device.disabled.en: This device provider is not enabled. No permission request or capture has started.
playx.device.disabled.zh-Hans: 设备服务尚未启用，未请求权限或开始采集

playx.device.scanCaptured.en: A code was captured. Review before sending.
playx.device.scanCaptured.zh-Hans: 已读取码，请核对后提交

playx.device.locationCaptured.en: A location was captured. Review before sending.
playx.device.locationCaptured.zh-Hans: 已获取位置，请核对后提交

playx.device.motionCaptured.zh-Hans: 已收到运动传感器采样

playx.stopwatch.local.en: This is a local challenge. It does not grant server rewards or complete a route.
playx.stopwatch.local.zh-Hans: 这是本地挑战，不会发放服务端奖励或完成路线

playx.stopwatch.running.zh-Hans: 正在计时，请凭体感判断

playx.stopwatch.early.en: Stopped at or before the target

playx.stillness.instructions.en: Keep the device steady. Background time is never counted.
playx.stillness.instructions.zh-Hans: 请保持设备平稳，后台时间不会计入

playx.advanced.timerNotice.en: The countdown is only a display. The server confirms timeout and completion.
playx.advanced.timerNotice.zh-Hans: 倒计时仅供显示，超时和完成由服务端确认

playx.advanced.stepsGate.en: This task requires a trusted step receipt that has not been accepted for this platform.
playx.advanced.stepsGate.zh-Hans: 此任务需要该平台尚未验收的可信步数回执

playx.advanced.specialGate.en: This kit's full native interaction is awaiting its dedicated provider or UI acceptance.
playx.advanced.specialGate.zh-Hans: 此玩法的完整原生交互仍待专用设备服务或界面验收

playx.advanced.turnsNotice.en: Roles and turns come from the server. Local interaction cannot complete another member's turn.
playx.advanced.turnsNotice.zh-Hans: 角色和轮次以服务端为准，本地交互不能代替其他成员完成

playx.advanced.review.en: Send this exact action to the current gameplay session?
playx.advanced.review.zh-Hans: 将此操作提交到当前玩法会话？

playx.player.submissionNotice.en: Recorded evidence can still require merchant verification. It is not automatically a completed task.
playx.player.submissionNotice.zh-Hans: 证据记录后仍可能需要商家核验，不代表任务自动完成

playx.circle.notice.en: This private card records your choices. It does not prove arrival, booking, redemption or purchase.
playx.circle.notice.zh-Hans: 私人记录卡仅记录自主选择，不代表商家确认到店、预约、核销或成交

playx.circle.closed.en: At least three current offers are required to open this instance.
playx.circle.closed.zh-Hans: 至少需要三家有效供给才能开放本实例

playx.circle.openUnknown.en: Opening may have succeeded. Recover the existing session before starting another.
playx.circle.openUnknown.zh-Hans: 创建或加入可能已成功，请先恢复已有会话，勿重复创建

playx.circle.shanghaiGate.en: City keyword pairing needs the recorded-store picker before submitting.
playx.circle.shanghaiGate.zh-Hans: 城市关键词提交前需要从已记录商家选择配对

playx.circle.date.q1.en: When did you last find each other especially endearing?
playx.circle.date.q1.zh-Hans: 最近一次觉得对方很可爱的瞬间？

playx.circle.date.q2.en: When did you last feel cared for by each other?
playx.circle.date.q2.zh-Hans: 最近一次被对方照顾到是什么时候？

playx.circle.date.q3.en: What would you like to do together next?
playx.circle.date.q3.zh-Hans: 下一次想一起认真做什么？

playx.circle.stage.SELF_MOMENT.en: A moment that felt like you

playx.director.noEvidence.en: The club cannot inspect private evidence here. It can request resubmission with a reason.
playx.director.noEvidence.zh-Hans: 俱乐部在此不查看私人凭证，只能填写理由要求重新提交

playx.director.recapPending.en: A recap has not been generated. Missing metrics are not shown as zero.
playx.director.recapPending.zh-Hans: 复盘尚未生成，不将缺失指标显示为零

playx.director.commandNotice.en: Review the current activity, server revision and selected people before sending. Unconfirmed actions stay locked.
playx.director.commandNotice.zh-Hans: 提交前核对当前场次、服务端版本和所选人员，结果未确认时将保持锁定

playx.director.sourceMember.zh-Hans: 当前已确认角色的成员

playx.director.etaNotice.en: Use the event's confirmed local date and time. No timezone is inferred.
playx.director.etaNotice.zh-Hans: 请填写本场已确认的当地日期时间，不自动推断时区

playx.director.invalid.en: The selection is incomplete or no longer allowed by the current server state.
playx.director.invalid.zh-Hans: 选择不完整，或当前服务端状态已不允许此操作

playx.director.finishNotice.en: This ends the current game session for its participants. Confirm only after reviewing the session.
playx.director.finishNotice.zh-Hans: 这将结束参与者的当前游戏会话，请核对后确认

playx.director.broadcastNotice.en: Send this exact broadcast to the selected audience in this activity?
playx.director.broadcastNotice.zh-Hans: 将这条广播发送给本场所选接收范围？

playx.prefab.runtimeNotice.en: Narrative choices are local. Arrival, photo upload and completion use separate server-verified steps.
playx.prefab.runtimeNotice.zh-Hans: 叙事选择保存在本机，到达、照片上传和完成使用独立的服务端验证步骤

playx.prefab.photo.consent.en: This will use the accepted camera provider and upload the selected image to the journey service. The hall step also sends your GCJ-02 location to verify arrival.
playx.prefab.photo.consent.zh-Hans: 将使用已验收的相机服务，并把所选图片上传至旅程服务；展馆步骤还会发送GCJ-02位置以验证到达

playx.prefab.sync.notice.en: Submit the uploaded hall photo to the first route node, then read the server state back. A local story or preview cannot prove completion.
playx.prefab.sync.notice.zh-Hans: 将已上传的展馆照片提交到路线首节点，再回读服务端状态；本地故事或预览不能证明完成

playx.prefab.prologue.en: Begin the source story, one scene at a time.
playx.prefab.prologue.zh-Hans: 开始源故事，逐个场景前进

playx.prefab.boot.instructions.en: Type “hello world” within ten seconds. Finishing within six seconds adds one local precision point.
playx.prefab.boot.instructions.zh-Hans: 十秒内输入“hello world”，六秒内完成会增加一点本地精密值

playx.prefab.boot.retry.en: The input was incorrect or timed out. Start again.
playx.prefab.boot.retry.zh-Hans: 输入有误或超时，请重新开始

playx.prefab.walk.local.en: This progress is a story animation. It does not prove physical movement or arrival.
playx.prefab.walk.local.zh-Hans: 此进度是故事动画，不代表真实移动或到达

playx.prefab.hall.instructions.en: Verify arrival at the first source node, then photograph the hall.
playx.prefab.hall.instructions.zh-Hans: 在源路线首节点验证到达，然后拍摄展馆

playx.prefab.birth.0.zh-Hans: 开心地呜呜丫丫叫起来

playx.prefab.birth.1.en: Look quietly out of the window

playx.prefab.count.en: How many people are looking at their phones?
playx.prefab.count.zh-Hans: 有几个人在低头看手机？

playx.prefab.teacher.timer.en: Choose within eight seconds, or the story continues with silence.
playx.prefab.teacher.timer.zh-Hans: 八秒内选择，否则故事将以沉默继续

playx.prefab.teacher.2.en: Ask whether there is a standard answer

playx.prefab.sticker.instructions.en: Place the source story's “unloaded map” sticker. This is board space, not a location report.
playx.prefab.sticker.instructions.zh-Hans: 放置源故事的“未加载地图”贴纸，这是画板坐标，不是位置上报

playx.prefab.boss.2.en: I would like to try this

playx.prefab.phone.privacy.en: Do not photograph faces. Use a back view, hands, or only the lit screen.
playx.prefab.phone.privacy.zh-Hans: 不拍脸，可以拍背影、手，或只有亮着的屏幕

playx.prefab.flow.en: Your local story is saved. On-site completion still needs server confirmation.
playx.prefab.flow.zh-Hans: 本地故事已保存，现场完成仍需服务端确认

playx.prefab.synced.zh-Hans: 现场记录已由服务端回读确认

playx.prefab.hold.dream.en: Wake after 1.5 foreground seconds. You can cancel at any time.
playx.prefab.hold.dream.zh-Hans: 前台持续1.5秒后醒来，可随时取消

playx.prefab.hold.birth.en: Remain here for three foreground seconds. You can cancel at any time.
playx.prefab.hold.birth.zh-Hans: 前台持续三秒，可随时取消

playx.prefab.quiz.2.1.en: A place you have never visited
playx.prefab.quiz.2.1.zh-Hans: 一块你从没去过的地方

playx.prefab.dream1.0.en: An endless white corridor, lined with doors.
playx.prefab.dream1.0.zh-Hans: 梦里的我在一条无尽的白色走廊，两边是一扇又一扇的门

playx.prefab.dream1.1.en: A map of cosmic microwave noise.
playx.prefab.dream1.1.zh-Hans: 我看到宇宙微波辐射的噪声图

playx.prefab.dream1.2.en: Stars collapse; planets drift from their orbits.
playx.prefab.dream1.2.zh-Hans: 恒星坍缩，行星偏移轨道

playx.prefab.dream1.3.en: The fossil record of dinosaur extinction.
playx.prefab.dream1.3.zh-Hans: 看到恐龙灭绝的化石记录

playx.prefab.dream1.4.en: Pyramids, lists of laborers, delayed schedules.
playx.prefab.dream1.4.zh-Hans: 金字塔开始建造，奴隶名单，工期延误

playx.prefab.dream1.6.en: The flash of an atomic test.
playx.prefab.dream1.6.zh-Hans: 我看到原子弹试爆的光

playx.prefab.dream1.7.en: Beethoven's score, copied again and again.
playx.prefab.dream1.7.zh-Hans: 我看到贝多芬的乐谱，一遍一遍被转录

playx.prefab.dream1.8.en: Beyond the final door: the window you saw this afternoon.
playx.prefab.dream1.8.zh-Hans: 最后一扇门后面，是今天下午你自己看过的那个窗外

playx.prefab.dream1.9.en: The input continues. I begin to dream.
playx.prefab.dream1.9.zh-Hans: 信息不断输入，我开始做梦

playx.prefab.dream2.0.en: The Earth forms; water covers its surface.
playx.prefab.dream2.0.zh-Hans: 我看到地球形成，水覆盖表面

playx.prefab.dream2.1.en: A single cell divides, repeating without purpose.
playx.prefab.dream2.1.zh-Hans: 单细胞分裂，没有目的，只是重复

playx.prefab.dream2.2.zh-Hans: 语言分化，同一个意思被反复误解

playx.prefab.dream2.3.zh-Hans: 边界被画在地图上，线条越来越粗

playx.prefab.dream2.4.en: Conscription lists, mostly ages eighteen to twenty-five.
playx.prefab.dream2.4.zh-Hans: 征兵名单，年龄集中在十八到二十五

playx.prefab.dream2.5.en: A court ruling. Someone stands; someone sits.
playx.prefab.dream2.5.zh-Hans: 法庭判决，有人站起，有人坐下

playx.prefab.dream2.6.zh-Hans: 工厂流水线，动作被标准化

playx.prefab.dream2.7.en: Home videos, birthdays, weddings and repeated takes.
playx.prefab.dream2.7.zh-Hans: 家庭录像带，生日、婚礼、一次次重拍

playx.prefab.dream2.8.en: I pass through that window again.

playx.prefab.dream2.9.en: Chat records, read without a reply.

playx.prefab.dream2.10.en: Searches for success, thinness and relief.
playx.prefab.dream2.10.zh-Hans: 搜索关键词：如何成功，如何变瘦，如何不痛苦

playx.prefab.dream2.11.en: A heart-rate trace rises at three in the morning.
playx.prefab.dream2.11.zh-Hans: 心率监测曲线，在凌晨三点突然升高

playx.prefab.dream3.3.en: No answer. Today, the door at the end is open.
playx.prefab.dream3.3.zh-Hans: 没有人回答，走廊尽头的那扇门今天是开着的

playx.director.copyRecap.zh-Hans: 复制已过滤隐私的复盘

playx.phase.unknownOpen.zh-Hans: 创建或加入结果待核对

playx.prefab.endings.fixed.en: These are the source story’s fixed ending descriptions, not a server-awarded result or live player statistics.
playx.prefab.endings.fixed.zh-Hans: 以下是源故事的固定结局说明，并非服务端判定的个人结果或实时玩家统计

playx.prefab.ending.0.quote.en: “Look, I am standing straight, my hands by my sides.”
playx.prefab.ending.0.quote.zh-Hans: “你看，我现在站得直直的，双手贴在裤缝边。”

playx.prefab.ending.0.condition.en: Nothing diverged. You lived the life arranged for you.
playx.prefab.ending.0.condition.zh-Hans: 什么都没有偏离，你过完了被安排好的一生

playx.prefab.ending.1.quote.en: “A younger you takes over. They stand straighter than you.”
playx.prefab.ending.1.quote.zh-Hans: “接手的是一个更年轻的你，他站得比你更直。”

playx.prefab.ending.1.condition.en: After chapter three, there were many clicks.
playx.prefab.ending.1.condition.zh-Hans: 在第三章之后，“咔哒”了很多次

playx.prefab.ending.2.quote.en: “The world allows you to exist, but will not fully accept you.”
playx.prefab.ending.2.quote.zh-Hans: “世界允许你存在，却不会完全接纳你。”

playx.prefab.ending.2.condition.en: You approached many times without opening the final boundary.
playx.prefab.ending.2.condition.zh-Hans: 你靠近过很多次，但没有推开最后那道边界

playx.prefab.ending.3.condition.en: See enough people, read every dream, then choose to stay.
playx.prefab.ending.3.condition.zh-Hans: 看见足够多的人，读完所有的梦，然后选择留下

playx.prefab.ending.4.quote.en: “Look. I am standing straight.” Then it leaves the screen.
playx.prefab.ending.4.quote.zh-Hans: “你看，我现在站得直直的。”然后它走出了屏幕

playx.prefab.ending.4.condition.en: Open the final boundary, having truly seen the city.
playx.prefab.ending.4.condition.zh-Hans: 推开最后那道边界，也需要你真的看过这座城市

playx.prefab.ending.5.condition.en: You opened the boundary, but nobody remembers you.
playx.prefab.ending.5.condition.zh-Hans: 推开了边界，但没有人记得你

playx.preference.completedNoResult.en: The server confirms this node is complete. No result text was recovered.
playx.preference.completedNoResult.zh-Hans: 服务端已确认此节点完成，尚未恢复结果正文

playx.preference.inherit.detail.en: Choose a source-provided tag to skip these questions, or answer again if your situation changed.
playx.preference.inherit.detail.zh-Hans: 选择服务端提供的标签可跳过本站题组；情况变化时也可重新作答

playx.preference.discard.en: Choose the option to set aside

playx.preference.submitNotice.en: Send these choices to generate this node's result? Only the server determines the outcome and next step.
playx.preference.submitNotice.zh-Hans: 提交这些选择以生成本站结果？结果和下一步由服务端决定

playx.preference.reuseNotice.en: Reuse the selected confirmed condition and skip this node's questions?
playx.preference.reuseNotice.zh-Hans: 沿用所选已确认条件，并跳过本站题组？

playx.os.private.en: Private build. Only visible to you.

playx.os.empty.en: No summary has been generated yet.

playx.os.week.en: Actions for the next seven days

playx.os.month.en: Actions for the next thirty days

playx.os.revokeNotice.en: After revocation, this tag will no longer be used for subsequent personalized recommendations. Server readback must confirm the change.
playx.os.revokeNotice.zh-Hans: 撤回后，此标签不再用于后续个性化推荐，变更需由服务端回读确认
